script_text: Cancer, the Moon is about to shake your world this week in ways you never expected. Early week, Mercury in your 10th House squares Pluto, bringing intense career conversations and power struggles at work — Tuesday is the toughest day as hidden tensions surface with authority figures. The turning point arrives Wednesday when Venus trines your ruling planet the Moon, flooding your 5th House of romance with magnetic energy and unexpected love opportunities. Late week, Jupiter sextiles your Sun from the 11th House, opening doors through friendships and social networks — Saturday brings a financial breakthrough through a group connection. Thursday is your power day because the Moon enters Cancer, amplifying your intuition and charm. Monday is your worst day due to that Mercury-Pluto square creating workplace conflict. Trust your gut feelings this week, Cancer — your water element intuition is your superpower. Follow for daily updates.
